title: GSE Linux Agent

tested_on.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
tested_on.note: Agent start-up, Panel Start and Stop, startserver.sh and stopserver.sh, orphaned-game clean-up (2026-11-12). Debian is untested.

prerequisites.name: Perl and the Perl modules in install_agent_prereqs.sh
prerequisites.note: libxml-parser-perl, libpath-class-perl, libarchive-extract-perl, libarchive-zip-perl, libhttp-daemon-perl, libfrontier-rpc-perl, libfile-copy-recursive-perl, libschedule-cron-perl, libio-compress-perl, libcompress-raw-zlib-perl, libfile-find-rule-perl, libwww-perl

prerequisites.name: screen, rsync, sudo, e2fsprogs, unzip, subversion, git, curl, bzip2
The agent user needs sudo without a password
prerequisites.note: The agent starts and stops games and changes game-folder permissions through sudo (or set sudo_password in Cfg/Config.pm). Without it Panel Start and Stop cannot work.

prerequisites.name: Root access to install
prerequisites.note: install_agent_prereqs.sh and install.sh must run as root (sudo).

unverified: The exact minimum Debian and Ubuntu release is not yet set or tested.
